title: Tidy the lane-lint PR-body change: two records, one test of the temp-file removal, one tie between the env name's two homes
why: #1932's round 3 notes (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 05:25 CST Nov 8): (1) decision merge-needs-current-base:25 says the small-move check "writes one temp file"; with a body it writes two. (2) merge.py's removal of the temp body file has no test; a mutant that drops it stays green. (3) Decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job lines 5-14 never say lane-lint reads the PR body. (4) CI_JOB_PR_BODY_FILE is named in merge.py and in bin/ci-job, and no test ties the two (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant).
note: Fix: each of the four, red cases first for (2) and (4). Branch lane-lint-body-tidy from #1932's head 5e75f57cd; its PR merges after #1932. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the lane. Filed 05:30 CST Nov 8; red cases started (lane, 05:25 CST).
